summary: The Ark is now drawn with its own shader (CosmicShore/Ark Hull): the same vessel-material colours and slot brightness, plus a key light fixed to the camera, fill, specular and rim, so the panels, ribs and jets read in voyages the way the studio render shows them. Shombith's call, 2026-11-16. Clearing hullShader on the asset restores the flat VesselGraph look.
